messages:
emily (CS): Heads-up — ACME Pay just escalated. After last night's v2 rollout they say summaries are truncating and tone is more terse, but only from EU-West (cluster eu-west-1). They provided two request IDs and a short prompt that reproduces it.

emily (CS): Request IDs: r_20260315_acme_01, r_20260315_acme_02. Customer insists it was fine pre-rollout. They want a root cause and ETA for fix. cc @tariq (oncall)

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Completed rollout job redwood/v2.0.3 -> prod (region: eu-west-1) at 2026-03-15T02:14Z :white_check_mark:

tariq (oncall): Thanks emily. I'm pulling logs for those request IDs now. Do we have the exact prompt + model and params they used?

emily (CS): Sent prompt in DM. Model used: redwood-v2.0.3, quantized variant q8k. temperature=0.7, max_tokens=256. Customer says US-east responses look normal.

sam (runtime): If it's region-specific, likely a routing or variant mismatch. eu-west may still be hitting q8k-legacy or a different kernel. Diego — any infra churn in EU around the deploy window?

diego (infra): No infra maintenance. But we had automatic instance replacement on one batch of p4d nodes at 02:17Z in eu-west-1. Replacement logs below:

```
2026-03-15T02:17:03Z instance-replace id=i-0abcde reason=OOM
2026-03-15T02:17:06Z attached gpu-driver=520.61 kernel=5.15.0-1023
2026-03-15T02:17:18Z start image pull redwood/runtime:v2.0.3
```

sam (runtime): OOM replacement could have triggered fallback to a different binary/quant path. I'm seeing a mismatch in the kernel selection table for eu-west nodes during 02:14-02:25Z. Oliva, can you confirm model pathing/quant table?

olivia (ml): Looking at model manifests: v2.0.3 -> primary q8k, fallback q4_0. For eu-west pool, one node still had an older libcudnn that triggers us to pick the q4_0 execution path for longer sequences, which can change output phrasing. That could explain terse summaries if kv-cache or attention kernels differ.

tariq (oncall): Repro plan: 1) replay r_20260315_acme_01/02 against eu-west pinned to q8k; 2) replay against us-east; 3) force q4_0 in us-east to compare. I can run step 1-2 now if I get the replay tool access.

sam (runtime): Also pull the request metadata: model_variant and binary_sha. If we accidentally rolled a variant with different tokenizer or detokenization hooks, that would also show region-only differences because of staged image rollout.

emily (CS): FYI customer provided the prompt (sanitized):

```
"Summarize the attached invoice thread and highlight any compliance concerns. Keep concise, avoid subjective language."
```

support-bot: audit-log: r_20260315_acme_01 -> assigned_node=node-euw-12 variant=q8k binary_sha=sha-9f3a2
support-bot: audit-log: r_20260315_acme_02 -> assigned_node=node-euw-17 variant=q4_0 binary_sha=sha-8b1c7

tariq (oncall): That audit-log line is telling — two different variants served for two sequential requests. node-euw-17 appears to have been using fallback variant. Diego, can you check why node-euw-17 didn't get the new runtime image?

diego (infra): node-euw-17 failed a healthcheck during the deploy and was kept on previous image. It was in the replacement rotation but rejoined with an older image because the image pull failed once due to transient S3 503. We'll repro image-pull logs.

olivia (ml): When a node serves q4_0 instead of q8k you can get different word choices and shorter outputs, esp. with constrained prompts. That matches customer symptoms. This is a config rollout/partial-deploy inconsistency, not model training bug.

sam (runtime): Mitigation options: 1) Force traffic away from node-euw-17 by draining it (hotfix) -> quick fix. 2) Rollback region to previous stable (v2.0.2) -> broader but slower. 3) Re-pull image and restart node, then verify variant table. I prefer 1 + image re-pull.

tariq (oncall): I'll drain node-euw-17 now and re-run the customer request against eu-west. If that fixes it we can confirm with ACME.

ops-bot: infra-action: drain node-euw-17 requested by @tariq at 2026-03-15T02:40Z

sam (runtime): After drain, run the exact request with same params and check token-level diffs. Use --diff-tokens flag on replay.

tariq (oncall): Replay done. Results: r_20260315_acme_02 replay AFTER drain now matches us-east output (tone restored, length back to expected). Token diffs attached (omitted here).

emily (CS): Great — I'll tell ACME we're isolating the node and will follow up within 1 hour. They asked for a postmortem and SLA credit if this impacted revenue.

olivia (ml): Root cause summary (prelim): partial rollout + image-pull failure led to heterogenous model variant mix in eu-west. Fallback quant variant q4_0 served some requests, changing generation characteristics.

diego (infra): Action items: 1) Re-pull runtime image on node-euw-17 and confirm healthcheck passes. 2) Add stricter pre-rollout gating for node image SHA matching. 3) Add repro test to cross-region verify variant mapping for a small prompt set.

sam (runtime): Also add an alert when variant entropy increases per-region (i.e., >1 model_variant seen for same model_id in a 5m window). That would have flagged this.

tariq (oncall): I'll keep node drained until we re-image and then coordinate ACME verification. Assigning follow-ups: @diego image/reimage, @sam add alert, @olivia prepare short postmortem/blame-free summary for customer.

emily (CS): Thanks all. I'll draft customer note: initial mitigation done, root cause identified, ETA for full fix 2-3 hours (reimage + verification). Will request SLA review/credits.

support-bot: ticket-update: ACME Escalation #12345 status=mitigated assigned=emily

emily (CS): Closing loop in 3h with final postmortem and remediation timeline. :thumbsup:
